about: Milliseconds vitest reports for one of Pele's tests run alone on the JavaScript build, before (main at 70579da, nim-regex in both builds) and after this step (JavaScript's own RegExp in the JavaScript build), on the 4-core sandbox, 15 November 2026. Measured with timings.sh beside this file, on tests.tsv: the tests whose profiles showed the most time in the regex library. Run to run they vary by a tenth or so.

tests.test: treeView worst cases box drawing, 10,000 rows
timeline worst cases 8,000 periods with one event each
journey worst cases one task with 16,000 actors
eventmodeling worst cases 1,000 frames that each name every earlier frame
cynefin worst cases 10,000 items in one domain
use case worst cases class statement with 2,500 ids and 4,000 classes

aboutCountsBefore: nim r tools/peletests.nim on round 3 (post Dates and styles in JavaScript) with main d1414ae merged, in this sandbox, 15 November 2026.
aboutCountsAfter: nim r tools/peletests.nim on this step's branch, in the same sandbox.

bridgeBytes.about: Size of the JavaScript bridge (tools/peletests/bridge.nim built with nim js -d:release): the JavaScript build no longer carries the regex engine.

rxbench.about: rxbench.nim of the post Dates and styles in JavaScript (data/dates_and_styles_in_javascript/), milliseconds per run in the JavaScript build, nim-regex then native.

rows.case: a g walk with two groups (matchAll)
a lexer: a sticky match at every token
